presets.description: A blank Gentoo variant for a configuration you want to build from scratch.
Fragtoo's Valve/Steam Deck starting point: existing Portage settings, Steam Deck kernel fragments, the two kernel targets, and source-backed patch mappings.

variant.name: Fragtoo Valve baseline
variant.make_conf:
COMMON_FLAGS="-march=znver2 -O2 -pipe"
CFLAGS="${COMMON_FLAGS}"
CXXFLAGS="${COMMON_FLAGS}"
FCFLAGS="${COMMON_FLAGS}"
FFLAGS="${COMMON_FLAGS}"
RUSTFLAGS="-C target-cpu=znver2"

CPU_FLAGS_X86="aes avx avx2 f16c fma3 mmx mmxext pclmul popcnt rdrand sha sse sse2 sse3 sse4_1 sse4_2 sse4a ssse3"
VIDEO_CARDS="amdgpu radeonsi"
INPUT_DEVICES="libinput"
ABI_X86="64 32"
variant.package_use:
gui-wm/gamescope avif libei luajit pipewire seatd wayland X
media-libs/mesa abi_x86_32 llvm lm-sensors -opencl proprietary-codecs vaapi vdpau vulkan vulkan-overlay wayland X zstd
games-util/mangohud abi_x86_32 dbus mangoapp wayland X -xnvctrl
media-video/pipewire abi_x86_32 bluetooth echo-cancel flatpak lv2 pipewire-alsa sound-server systemd v4l
sys-apps/systemd boot policykit
variant.accept_keywords:
app-admin/ryzen_smu ~amd64
app-misc/fragtoo-meta ~amd64
sys-config/fragtoo-configs-valve ~amd64
sys-kernel/fragtoo-kernel ~amd64
sys-kernel/fragtoo-valve-kernel ~amd64
sys-kernel/fragtoo-patches ~amd64
variant.patches:
sys-kernel/fragtoo-kernel: the ebuild generates the Valve delta by diffing vanilla Linux 7.3 plus the upstream stable patch against the Valve Neptune 7.3.1 source; it excludes Makefile, hid-asus.c, and amdgpu_dm_connector.c.
sys-kernel/fragtoo-kernel local patches:
sys-kernel/fragtoo-kernel/files/fix-hdmi-frl-status-polling-work-linkage.patch
sys-kernel/fragtoo-kernel/files/fix-ath11k-unitest-makefile.patch
sys-kernel/fragtoo-kernel/files/fix-binutils-247-module-relocs.patch
sys-kernel/fragtoo-valve-kernel: builds the Valve Neptune source directly and merges config.x86_64 with config-neptune; the ebuild declares no additional local patch files.
sys-kernel/fragtoo-patches installs the separately maintained compatibility patches:
sys-kernel/fragtoo-patches/files/fix-hdmi-frl-status-polling-work-linkage.patch
sys-kernel/fragtoo-patches/files/fix-ath11k-unitest-makefile.patch
sys-kernel/fragtoo-patches/files/fix-binutils-247-module-relocs.patch
variant.kernel_config:

CONFIG_MFD_STEAMDECK=m
CONFIG_SENSORS_STEAMDECK=m
CONFIG_EXTCON_STEAMDECK=m
CONFIG_LEDS_STEAMDECK=m
CONFIG_LEDS_VALVE=m
CONFIG_HID_STEAM=m
CONFIG_STEAM_FF=y
CONFIG_HID_BPF=y
CONFIG_NTSYNC=m
CONFIG_PINCTRL_AMD=y
CONFIG_I2C_DESIGNWARE_CORE=y
CONFIG_I2C_DESIGNWARE_PLATFORM=y
CONFIG_I2C_DESIGNWARE_PCI=y
CONFIG_REGMAP_I2C=y
CONFIG_REGMAP_SPI=y

# CONFIG_KUNIT is not set
# CONFIG_KUNIT_ALL_TESTS is not set

# From sys-kernel/fragtoo-kernel/files/steamdeck-gpu.config
CONFIG_DRM_AMDGPU=m
CONFIG_DRM_AMDGPU_USERPTR=y
CONFIG_DRM_AMD_ACP=y

CONFIG_HSA_AMD_SVM=y
CONFIG_AMD_PMC=m
CONFIG_AMD_PMF=m
CONFIG_X86_AMD_PSTATE=y
CONFIG_X86_AMD_PSTATE_DEFAULT_MODE=3

# From sys-kernel/fragtoo-kernel/files/steamdeck-audio.config
CONFIG_SND_SOC_AMD_ACP5x=m
CONFIG_SND_SOC_AMD_VANGOGH_MACH=m
CONFIG_SND_SOC_AMD_ACP_COMMON=m
CONFIG_SND_SOC_ACPI_AMD_MATCH=m
CONFIG_SND_SOC_SOF_AMD_TOPLEVEL=m
CONFIG_SND_SOC_SOF_AMD_COMMON=m
CONFIG_SND_SOC_SOF_AMD_VANGOGH=m
CONFIG_SND_SOC_NAU8821=m
CONFIG_SND_SOC_CS35L41=m
CONFIG_SND_SOC_CS35L41_LIB=m
CONFIG_SND_SOC_CS35L41_I2C=m
CONFIG_SND_SOC_CS35L41_SPI=m
CONFIG_SND_SOC_MAX98388=m

# From sys-kernel/fragtoo-kernel/files/steamdeck-sched.config
CONFIG_PREEMPT=y
CONFIG_PREEMPT_DYNAMIC=y
CONFIG_HZ_1000=y
CONFIG_HZ=1000
CONFIG_NO_HZ_FULL=y
CONFIG_SCHED_CLASS_EXT=y
CONFIG_RCU_LAZY=y

CONFIG_ZRAM=m
CONFIG_ZRAM_BACKEND_ZSTD=y
CONFIG_ZRAM_DEF_COMP_ZSTD=y
CONFIG_ZSWAP=y
CONFIG_ZSWAP_DEFAULT_ON=y
CONFIG_ZSWAP_COMPRESSOR_DEFAULT_ZSTD=y

app-admin/ryzen_smu
app-misc/fragtoo-meta
net-wireless/iw
